card.name: Arterial and venous vessel terms
card.fires_on: The word 'arterial' (or its ending 'ial' in 'Arterial') and 'venous' in vascular terms like pulmonary arterial hypertension and thromboembolic events. Also fires on 'river' in water and land-resource text.
